narr: A warm front with moisture laden air lifted into the area during the day, and an approaching shortwave trough supported developing thunderstorm activity. With the atmospheric moisture content at a daily maximum based on upper air sounding records, torrential rainfall with rainfall rates of 3 inches an hour or greater were anticipated. However, the storms were discrete or small in size and progressed at speeds of 30 mph, limiting coverage and exposure times. Therefore, most locations that received heavy rainfall were able to do so without impacts. The one exception was when a storm cluster moved over the urban areas of Auburn and Lewiston Maine.
